Container.Name: codex-terminal
Container.Overview: SSH and browser-accessible Codex CLI environment for Codex Desktop Remote SSH and direct WebUI access. Unraid management is routed through the internal Unraid MCP sidecar, with optional media and utility MCP sidecars.
Container.Requires: Create the Docker network first: docker network create codex-mgmt. Deploy unraid-mcp on the same network before connecting Codex.

Config.Name: SSH Port
Config.Description: Host port for SSH into the Codex container. Expose only on LAN, VPN, or Tailscale.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the browser terminal. Expose only on LAN, VPN, or Tailscale.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Codex config, SSH host keys, authorized keys, cache, and workspace.

Config.Name: Media Diagnostics Mount
Config.Description: Optional narrow read-only media share mount for path diagnosis only. Select an existing path with the exact capitalization shown under /mnt/user; do not mount broad /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Downloads Diagnostics Mount
Config.Description: Optional narrow existing downloads share mount. Preserve the exact share-name capitalization and leave empty unless you need shell-side archive checks or extraction; do not mount broad /mnt/user.

Config.Name: SSH Authorized Keys
Config.Description: One or more public SSH keys. Leave blank only if you intentionally enable password login.

Config.Name: Enable SSH Password Login
Config.Description: Default is false. If true, set exactly one of SSH Password or SSH Password Hash.

Config.Name: SSH Password
Config.Description: Plaintext password for the codex SSH user, used only when SSH_PASSWORD_LOGIN=true. Use a strong password and expose SSH only on LAN, VPN, or Tailscale.

Config.Name: SSH Password Hash
Config.Description: Optional crypt-format password hash for the codex SSH user. Set exactly one password field when SSH_PASSWORD_LOGIN=true.

Config.Name: WebUI Password
Config.Description: Password for the required codex WebUI login.

Config.Name: Auto Launch Codex
Config.Description: Automatically starts Codex CLI in the WebUI tmux session on container start.

Config.Name: WebUI Codex Bypass Approvals
Config.Description: Starts WebUI Codex with --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox. The container boundary remains the primary sandbox.

Config.Name: Media Path Maps
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated source=mounted-path mappings for media-path-check, such as /downloads=/mnt/unraid/downloads,/media=/mnt/unraid/media.

Config.Name: Unraid MCP Bearer Token
Config.Description: Bearer token used by Codex to authenticate to the internal Unraid MCP sidecar. Must match the sidecar.

Config.Name: Media MCP Bearer Token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token used by Codex to authenticate to media-mcp. Leave blank to skip adding the media MCP server to Codex config.

Config.Name: Utilities MCP Bearer Token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token used by Codex to authenticate to utilities-mcp. Leave blank to skip adding the utilities MCP server to Codex config.
